## agent-team

**Commands**

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/agents` | Agent bar; questions; auto on\|off\|status; view/spawn/send/stop/inbox/reports batch\|quiet\|status\|flush |

**Shortcuts**

| Key | Description |
|---|---|
| `ctrl+q` | Select next agent below the input |
| `ctrl+alt+q` | Select previous agent below the input |
| `ctrl+x` | Stop the selected managed agent |

### `agent_spawn`

Start an independent Pi worker; returns its ID immediately and reports settled results automatically. Inherits cwd/model/thinking, not chat history. Workers share files in the same cwd and survive parent exit. role (explorer/executor/reviewer/verifier) picks a model tier, read-only tools and a SUMMARY/CHANGES/CHECKS/BLOCKERS report. For a Change Loop execution.mode parallel envelope, spawn one worker per lease with changeLoopTask {change, task, tier?}. Limits: maxActiveWorkers (default 64), the project's execution.maxParallelAgents in Change Loop projects, depth 3.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | string | no | min length 1, max length 65536 |
| `name` | string | no | max length 80 |
| `cwd` | string | no |  |
| `provider` | string | no |  |
| `model` | string | no |  |
| `role` | "explorer" \| "executor" \| "reviewer" \| "verifier" | no |  |
| `changeLoopTask` | { change, task, tier } | no |  |

### `agent_list`

Default: self and active descendants, compact rows, 20 per page (max 50). scope all discovers other sessions; includeInactive includes archived/stopped agents. Use nextOffset as offset for more. id accepts ID, session ID, unique name, parent or self and bypasses list filters. details requires id and returns bounded task/result previews plus paths for reading full files. Idle workers accept follow-ups.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | no |  |
| `details` | boolean | no |  |
| `scope` | "team" \| "all" | no |  |
| `includeInactive` | boolean | no |  |
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1, max 50 |
| `offset` | integer | no | min 0 |

```json

    },

      "type": "boolean"
    },

}
```

### `agent_send`

Send a durable message to an ID, session ID, unique name, parent or self. followUp waits for the current run; steer corrects at a tool boundary. Idle receivers start automatically; offline receivers wait for resume. Queued is not completed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | string | yes |  |
| `message` | string | yes | min length 1, max length 65536 |
| `delivery` | "followUp" \| "steer" | no |  |

### `agent_inbox`

Read compact inbox previews (10 per page, max 20). unreadOnly excludes delivered messages. Use nextOffset as offset for more. Provide id to read message text in chunks (4000 characters, max 8000), using nextTextOffset as textOffset. Full envelope/details remain at the returned file path. Reading does not consume messages or trigger work.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1, max 20 |
| `unreadOnly` | boolean | no |  |
| `offset` | integer | no | min 0 |
| `id` | string | no |  |
| `textOffset` | integer | no | min 0 |
| `maxChars` | integer | no | min 1, max 8000 |

### `agent_stop`

Request shutdown of a managed worker (ID/name/self), including descendants by default. Cancels its turns and bash jobs; force-kills its owned process after 3s if needed. History is retained. Verify stopped with agent_list; independent interactive sessions cannot be killed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `includeChildren` | boolean | no |  |

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "includeChildren": {
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  }
}
```

</details>

### `ask_user`

Persist a user question in the question inbox. Returns immediately with an ID; it is NOT an answer. Only the user can resolve it via /questions. Use either { question, options?, multiSelect? } or { questions: [1-4 × { question, header?, options?, multiSelect? }] } answered together. Options are text or { label, description?, recommended?, preview? (markdown) }; the user can always type their own answer and add notes. Reuse the same key for retries. No expiry or automatic dismissal.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | Stable key; reuse it unchanged for retries; min length 1, max length 120 |
| `question` | string | no | Single question (use either question or questions); min length 1, max length 6000 |
| `header` | string | no | max length 24 |
| `options` | (string \| { label, description, recommended, preview })[] | no | max items 8 |
| `multiSelect` | boolean | no |  |
| `questions` | { question, header, options, multiSelect }[] | no | 1-4 related questions answered together in one tabbed dialog; min items 1, max items 4 |

## background-bash

**Commands**

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/jobs` | Open background jobs and logs: /jobs [log\|stop <job-id>] |

**Shortcuts**

| Key | Description |
|---|---|
| `ctrl+b` | Background waiting bash commands, or open the jobs panel |
| `ctrl+alt+b` | Open background jobs and live logs |

### `background_bash`

Start bash -c with no stdin; return a persistent job ID immediately. Inherits session environment; survives Pi exit/reload. Completion notifies automatically unless notify=false. Cannot adopt an existing process.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | string | yes |  |
| `cwd` | string | no | Working directory, relative to project cwd or absolute |
| `timeoutSeconds` | number | no | min 1, max 604800 |
| `notify` | boolean | no | Omit for batched automatic reporting (successful bare sleep and intentional stops stay silent). true explicitly requests completion reporting, including timers; false disables reporting. |

<details><summary>JSON schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "command"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "command": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "cwd": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Working directory, relative to project cwd or absolute"
    },
    "timeoutSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 604800
    },
    "notify": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Omit for batched automatic reporting (successful bare sleep and intentional stops stay silent). true explicitly requests completion reporting, including timers; false disables reporting."
    }
  }
}
```

</details>

### `background_job`

Compact paginated job list: active only by default, 20 per page (max 50). includeFinished includes history. status never includes logs. log returns up to 8 KiB by default (max 32 KiB); use byteOffset and nextByteOffset to page from byte 0, or omit byteOffset for the tail. Full logPath remains available. Reading a terminal status/log acknowledges its completion notification. Completion reports are batched while idle: do not poll.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | "list" \| "status" \| "log" \| "stop" | yes |  |
| `id` | string | no |  |
| `lines` | integer | no | min 1, max 500 |
| `includeFinished` | boolean | no |  |
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1, max 50 |
| `offset` | integer | no | min 0 |
| `byteOffset` | integer | no | min 0 |
| `maxBytes` | integer | no | min 1, max 32768 |

### `task_board`

Persistent tasks across sessions. list/get; create needs key/title; update/delete/restore need id/version. delete is recoverable; list deleted:true shows trash. plan checks readiness/topology; brief(id) prepares a compact handoff. handoff assigns an existing session without spawn/message. inbox/agents/list/plan paginate via offset/limit (default 20); agents includeInactive:true includes offline. graph checks dependencies; sync/link reuse Change Loop records. Status is not execution or approval. Details: tool_guide tasks/agents.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | "list" \| "get" \| "create" \| "update" \| "delete" \| "restore" \| "sync" \| "link" \| "graph" \| "plan" \| "brief" \| "agents" \| "handoff" \| "inbox" | yes |  |

| `includeInactive` | boolean | no |  |
| `deleted` | boolean | no |  |
| `id` | string | no |  |
| `changeId` | string | no |  |
